command: OTHMODE — MYTHOS ERP BACKEND EVOLUTION — SEARCH FIRST: design and implement the secure multi-user backend (auth/RBAC/DB/API/uploads/audit); build+test locally, do not expose

preflight.environment: Claude Code remote sandbox — PHP 8.4 (PDO, pdo_sqlite, argon2id, sodium, finfo present); no host/SSH access; owner mandate: build+test locally, gated shut, do not expose.

search_first.repo_reuse: OTHMODE session pattern (hashed session ids, __Host- HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict cookie, fail-closed); legacy ALLOWED_KEYS list (hardened); api.php request shape (compat).
search_first.stdlib_reuse: PHP-native argon2id (password_hash), hash_equals, random_bytes, finfo magic-byte MIME — no Composer deps, no supply chain.
search_first.external_research: OWASP Session Management / Password Storage / CSRF Prevention / File Upload cheat sheets; 2026 OSS ERP + client-lib landscape (already in capability audit).
search_first.rejected: FastAPI/Django/Node/Laravel/Symfony (new-runtime re-platforms); full OSS ERP (re-platform, discards domain modules).

execution.decision: Secure PHP 8.4 + SQLite(WAL) backend, portable to MariaDB; drop-in-compatible with api.php's collection contract so the frontend transitions without a rewrite (compatibility-oriented, not big-bang).
execution.built: projects/erp-backend/: schema.sql; src/{bootstrap,db,auth,rbac,audit,api,uploads}.php; public/index.php (front controller); cli/{migrate,create-user,import-localstorage}.php; tests/{unit-test.php,security-test.sh}; deploy/{nginx-erp-backend.conf,.env.example}; README.md.

changes.added: projects/erp-backend/ (new, self-contained). No production code touched; legacy api.php/upload.php left disabled and untouched; nothing exposed.

validation.security-test (php -S + curl, §17): 24/0 — unauth denied; uniform login errors; HttpOnly cookie; auth read; CSRF enforced; optimistic concurrency 409; traversal + unknown key 400; viewer write/upload 403; php-as-pdf 415 (magic bytes) + no .php written; logout invalidation; audit rows; session stored as sha256 hash only
validation.migration-tool: verified — valid collections imported, traversal/unknown keys skipped, audit recorded
validation.secret-scan: clean — no hardcoded secrets (passwords via env/stdin; DB + uploads off-repo; .gitignore guards runtime files)

sections.deployment: NONE. Deploy artifacts prepared and gated. Public activation requires: owner DNS approval + host access + the on-host §17 re-run; the frontend wiring (js/core/api.js base URL + credentials + CSRF header, login UI replacing js/auth.js) is a follow-up stage gated behind deployment.
sections.problems: Not blocked for the build (done + tested locally). Remaining items are gated: public deployment (owner DNS + host), frontend transition (follow-up stage), server-side notifications/jobs (systemd timer calling a PHP job — design documented), backup/restore (REUSE the existing off-host backup tooling, not a parallel mechanism).
sections.outcome: Secure multi-user backend reference implemented and fully verified in-repo, gated shut. This is the single architectural evolution the capability audit named as the ERP's ceiling; it now exists as reviewable, tested, deployment-ready code.
